column1: # As readable_locals.tsv, BMX XXX (game 2): the rows of functions word-identical in both games (the bind table's body rows). A corpus build reads this file too.
# (locals1) The shared body's four Locals at the original's places (as AI's: faceVertices gets sp+0xA0, faceNormal
# sp+0x60, vertexPosition sp+0x70/0x80/0x90, the triangle sp+0x30/0x40/0x50). Nine rows of an older body put them at
# 0x00/0x30/0x40/0x50: corners[1] wrote over indices before the third corner read it.
# (tested2) A place is the Local's in the order the function makes them as it runs (ee::frameLocal counts them at run
# time): setPathManState makes text alone on the no-animation path and rootPosition, position on the root move's, the
# original's sp+0 (formatString's buffer there) and sp+0x10. Ordinals by the source's order put position at text's
# second place, sp+0 on rootPosition: the root move kept the root bone's height (s-rmpg 6596-6826, 0.96 lower).
# (locals1) resting and returning, each its case's block, are both ordinal 1: the original keeps both at sp+0.
# (locals1) From ordinal 6: the wary case's fromRider (sp+0x70 in the original), and flyBird's and returnBird's Locals,
# which run in updateBird's frame (plain helpers), at the original's places of each state's vectors.
